metadata.question: Did the Alisal Fire cover less than 10,000 acres from October 11, 2021 to October 13, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - The Alisal Fire occurred in California (Santa Barbara County area) from October 11-13, 2021 - Need to detect burned area using appropriate satellite data - Sentinel-2 has 10m resolution, good for fire detection - Can use NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) or thermal bands to detect active fire/burned areas - May need to compare pre-fire and during/post-fire imagery 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds as they would interfere with burn detection - Use SCL band for Sentinel-2 cloud masking 3. Logic: - Calculate burned area in acres - If area < 10,000 acres → A (Yes) - If area >= 10,000 acres → B (No) - Handle cases where no data exists (C1), no valid pixels (C2), or calculation fails (C3) - 1 acre = 4046.86 square meters 4. Approach: - Define geometry around Alisal Fire location (near Santa Barbara, CA) - Get pre-fire baseline (early October 2021) - Get during/post-fire imagery (Oct 11-13, 2021) - Calculate NBR difference to detect burned areas - Calculate total burned area and compare to 10,000 acres ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Alisal Fire location (Santa Barbara County, California) const fireRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-120.3, 34.4, -119.9, 34.7]); // Date ranges const preFireStart = '2021-10-01'; const preFireEnd = '2021-10-10'; const fireStart = '2021-10-11'; const fireEnd = '2021-10-13'; // Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskClouds(image) { const scl = image.select('SCL'); const mask = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // NBR calculation function addNBR(image) { const nbr = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B12']).rename('NBR'); return image.addBands(nbr); } // Get pre-fire imagery let preFireCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(fireRegion) .filterDate(preFireStart, preFireEnd) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNBR); console.log('Pre-fire images:', preFireCol.size().getInfo()); if (preFireCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No pre-fire Sentinel-2 data, trying Landsat 8...'); preFireCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(fireRegion) .filterDate(preFireStart, preFireEnd) .map(function(img) { const nbr = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B7']).rename('NBR'); return img.addBands(nbr); }); console.log('Pre-fire Landsat images:', preFireCol.size().getInfo()); } if (preFireCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No pre-fire data available.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get during/post-fire imagery let postFireCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(fireRegion) .filterDate(fireStart, fireEnd) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNBR); console.log('Post-fire images:', postFireCol.size().getInfo()); if (postFireCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No post-fire data, extending date range to Oct 14-20...'); postFireCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(fireRegion) .filterDate(fireStart, '2021-10-20') .map(maskClouds) .map(addNBR); console.log('Extended post-fire images:', postFireCol.size().getInfo()); } if (postFireCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No post-fire data available.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Create composite images const preFire = preFireCol.select('NBR').median(); const postFire = postFireCol.select('NBR').median(); // Calculate dNBR (difference NBR) const dNBR = preFire.subtract(postFire).rename('dNBR'); // Threshold for burned areas (dNBR > 0.1 typically indicates burn) const burnedArea = dNBR.gt(0.1); // Count valid pixels const pixelCount = burnedArea.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: fireRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('dNBR').getInfo(); console.log('Valid pixels:', pixelCount); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate burned area in square meters const areaSqMeters = burnedArea.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: fireRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('dNBR').getInfo(); if (areaSqMeters === null || areaSqMeters === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert to acres (1 acre = 4046.86 square meters) const areaAcres = areaSqMeters / 4046.86; console.log('Burned area: ' + areaAcres.toFixed(0) + ' acres'); console.log('Threshold: 10,000 acres'); if (areaAcres < 10000) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
